notes.title: Update 2, v1.0.1 - Rapid Fire & bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello,

Thanks to your feedback and comments, we just uploaded a new update for Raiden Legacy Steam Edition.

This update adds, among other things, the Rapid Fire. Use ALT (keyboard) or X (controller) to shoot continuously. You can change the button configuration in the options.    

The complete changelog:

- Rapid Fire addition
- higher default screen resolution
- default HD music
- fix for input issues in ship select screen

We are still investigating and working on the FPS issue and hope to bring you some good news soon.

Thank you for your patience and understanding. 

The DotEmu Team

tags.bug: - fix for input issues in ship select screen

notes.title: Update 1
notes.content:
Hello,

Thanks to your feedback, we've just uploaded a first update for the game:

- Fix Game Over issue on Raiden
- Minor fixes on emulation engine for Raiden Fighters 1, 2 and Jet

We are still investigating on others reported issues and we will let you know as soon as we find a solution. 

Thanks for your patience and sorry for the inconvenience.

The DotEmu Team
